chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Nadr from 'Asim from Abu Basir said:

The moon was eclipsed while I was with Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) in the month of Ramadan, so he stood up quickly and said, 'It used to be said: When the moon and the sun are eclipsed, hasten to your mosques.'
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say to do when the sun or moon is eclipsed?
ai.summary: This narration from Sahih al-Tusi highlights the immediate ritual response of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to a lunar eclipse during Ramadan, linking celestial events to spiritual reflection. It underscores the continuity of the Prophetic tradition (Sunnah) regarding the Sun and Moon eclipses as signs of Allah, emphasizing the urgency of congregational prayer and supplication in mosques. This incident serves as a practical demonstration of how the Imams interpreted and enacted the cosmic signs mentioned in the Quran.
